note: Genome v1 requirements, each traced to where it is implemented and the tests that verify it (src/lib/genome/governance.test.ts checks every file and test named here exists). Status is one of implemented, proposed, incomplete or requires-qualified-review. 'Implemented' means built and verified by these tests; it does not mean validated for any clinical purpose, and passing tests do not establish clinical validity, safety or regulatory compliance. No requirement has been released: there is no release yet.

requirements.statement: Accept GRCh38 only. Reject any other or mixed reference build with a clear reason, and never guess a build from chromosome names.

verification.test: accepts GRCh38 named in ##reference, in several spellings
rejects mixed evidence rather than picking a side
does not guess a build from chromosome names alone
test_a_non_grch38_answer_is_refused

requirements.statement: Check VCF headers only (versions 4.2 to 4.5). Read no variant records, reject compressed and non-VCF input, and never return sample names.

verification.test: rejects versions it does not recognise
rejects files that are not VCF, or are compressed
counts samples but never returns their names

requirements.statement: No liftover, build conversion or version rewriting anywhere.

verification.test: does not guess a build from chromosome names alone
keeps the GRCh38 location only and never converts a GRCh37 one
contains no liftover or build conversion

requirements.statement: Keep gene registration separate from panel membership. The first IRD panel stays proposed and non-authoritative while D5 is unresolved; RHO stays a test gene outside every panel.

verification.test: the first IRD panel is proposed, D5 unresolved, and not authoritative
cannot be approved while its decision is unresolved
the spec lists the product owner's ten proposed genes; only RPE65 is configured
keeps RHO a test gene outside every panel

requirements.statement: Decide separately, per source, whether it may be fetched, stored, displayed or redistributed, for research, commercial-pilot or clinical use. Fail closed: only a recorded 'allowed' permits an action.

verification.test: fails closed on unknown, missing, pending and undecided entries
denies redistribution of every source: none is confirmed
test_the_policy_fails_closed_for_missing_pending_and_unknown_entries
test_policy_decisions_match_the_inventory

requirements.statement: Content from a source the policy refuses is never fetched, stored, displayed, exported or served. Show only the policy's explanation.
requirements.source: LICENCES.md (ClinVar: requires legal review; NCBI notice: app use blocked)

verification.test: test_clinvar_is_never_requested_and_is_recorded_as_withheld
withholds ClinVar without requesting any ClinVar file
carries the statement, the withheld list, and nothing from ClinVar
test_no_clinvar_file_or_request_url_is_served
renders a withheld source as an accessible note with its reason

requirements.statement: Do not serve raw source responses. Serve a display copy holding only the fields the app reads, from sources whose display is permitted.

verification.test: holds, per file, exactly the fields the app's parsers read from the raw response
test_raw_snapshots_are_not_served
test_a_source_whose_display_is_refused_is_withheld_not_written

requirements.statement: Record provenance for every value and file: source, URL, release, retrieval time, identifiers and SHA-256, in deterministic manifests; record any later redaction.

verification.test: test_manifest_is_deterministic_in_layout
test_digests_match_the_stored_files
test_the_committed_display_copy_is_current_and_deterministic
test_every_manifest_file_is_present_with_its_digest_or_recorded_as_redacted
traces every display file to its raw response and its source
gives the same digest for the same records in any key order

requirements.statement: Keep evidence categories apart: what a source reports, what this software computes, and what is a hypothesis. Nothing is labelled clinically validated without a validation record.

verification.test: refuses to label anything clinically validated without a validation record
separates what ClinVar states from what is derived here
treats an unreported identifier as incomplete, not as agreement

requirements.statement: Show a plain statement that the software is not for clinical decision-making on every Vision screen and in every export, from one source, with a status panel separating research, unvalidated, blocked, proposed and future work.

verification.test: shows the not-for-clinical-use statement in the status panel
uses one statement across screens, exports and records
groups every status item under exactly one of the five headings
carries the statement, the withheld list, and nothing from ClinVar

requirements.statement: Clinical mode, patient-specific interpretation and clinical claims stay unavailable unless every required item of evidence is verified and backed by a recorded approval. No configuration toggle alone can enable them.

verification.test: is unavailable today, with one unmet reason per required item
cannot be opened by setting its status field
refuses evidence marked verified without a recorded approval
denies clinical use of everything, and the release gate alone cannot open it

requirements.statement: Process no patient data on the Genome and Vision pages: no genomic or clinical data upload, no patient identifiers, no sample names in output. The eye page's picture picker accepts images only, processed in the browser and never stored or sent.

verification.test: offers no genomic or clinical data upload on the Genome, Genomics and Vision pages
counts samples but never returns their names

requirements.statement: Use a source or component in a commercial pilot only once the licence inventory marks it approved after a named person's review.

verification.test: approves nothing for commercial pilots until reviewed
denies commercial-pilot use of everything: nothing is approved
test_commercial_pilot_mode_fetches_nothing_unapproved

requirements.statement: If cross-species comparison is added: keep direct source observations, computed mappings and hypotheses separate; record source, method, version, taxon, identifiers and caveats; never present orthology or pathway overlap as proof of causation or clinical relevance.

verification.test: tells 'not retrieved' from 'none reported'
places a gene against the baseline, and refuses to compare what is not comparable
groups species by the ancestors they share, whatever order a source lists them in
names a deviation in words, with its baseline and count

requirements.note: Orthologues are shown as Ensembl reports them (source observation); the species tree, baseline and deviation are computed here and labelled as such; no orthologue is presented as functional equivalence.

requirements.statement: A clinical intended use, regulatory determination, analytical and clinical validation, and quality release, before any clinical function.
requirements.note: Needs qualified clinical, regulatory, genomics, legal and quality reviewers. None has been appointed or consulted.

requirements.statement: Before ClinVar can be shown: display NCBI's required disclaimer and copyright notice in the exact wording NCBI provides, and complete the legal review of ClinVar reuse.
requirements.note: The notice's wording has not been verified from NCBI and is not reproduced in the app. A person must take it from NCBI's own pages; legal review must approve reuse.

requirements.statement: Choose the Vision target from the gene registry rather than a hard-coded gene, offering only genes that are the current focus, have verified identifiers and have a display copy. This implies no panel approval.

verification.test: offers only current-focus, verified genes with a display copy as targets

requirements.statement: Build the research gene library only from the source's curations: a gene is included when a ClinGen gene-disease validity curation's disease label matches a library condition, with the classification, disease identifier, inheritance, expert panel, date and report link kept verbatim. Add no gene, association or classification by hand, and never merge conflicting curations into one verdict.

verification.test: test_conditions_match_the_source_label_verbatim
keeps ClinGen's classification words and a report link on every curation
keeps conflicting curations apart and flags the conflict
explains a condition with no curated gene instead of filling it

requirements.statement: Label sample data as synthetic wherever it appears, use it only when no capture exists, and never mix it with captured or live data.

verification.test: is synthetic, labelled, valid and has no made-up taxonomy
shows a captured snapshot as it is, with no sample genes mixed in
reports a broken, unreachable or mislabelled file as an error, not as sample data
labels sample data as synthetic, everywhere it appears

requirements.statement: Read third-party sources through an adapter on the server for live checks: validate the response, time out, retry only what may succeed, report each source's outcome separately, apply the source policy before any request, and never change the captured snapshot.

verification.test: reports a partial outage per source and keeps what did arrive
retries a 503 and a 429, but not a 404
asks nothing of a source the policy refuses

requirements.statement: Give every feature one of four statuses (working, connected but limited, sample/demo, planned), state what it runs on, show captured data's date from its own manifest, and claim no live, real-time or clinical capability.

verification.test: claims no live, real-time or clinical capability
reads 'data as of' from manifests that exist, with a capture time
